items.description: Samudra Dyan Praga was founded in 1984 as a stand contractor focused on providing superior exhibition construction services to clients based in Indonesia.
The company expanded its scope to offer full exhibition management services, supporting clients in domestic and overseas expositions, trade fairs, and exhibitions.
Further growth and consolidation of services, establishing a stronger presence in key Indonesian markets.
Continued expansion of operations and improvement of service quality, laying the groundwork for future milestones.

A landmark era of growth: joined OSPI (Octanorm Service Partner International) and achieved ISO 9001:2015 Certification for Quality Management Systems. The company grew to become the biggest stand contractor in Indonesia with branches across multiple cities.
Entering a new chapter of innovation, digital transformation, and sustainable exhibition solutions while continuing to serve clients across Indonesia and internationally.
